title: Redstrike Content Map
description: The content-discovery recon feeder's content.json: the crawled/brute-forced surface map (routes, discovered params, notable sinks, crawl method) that seeds the console Site Map and the vuln executors. Content-discovery output varies a lot with the target (locale explosion, API-only surfaces, static sites), so this schema is TOLERANT by design — nothing is required and extra keys are allowed; it type-checks the canonical fields the console reads WHEN present (routes[]/params_discovered[] are arrays, notable_sinks is an object, crawl_method is a string) so a field that drifts to the wrong shape and would break the Site Map is caught, while a legitimately different producer layout still validates clean.

crawl_method.description: how the surface was discovered (sitemap crawl / historical URLs / brute-force / proxy history).

method.description: accepted alias some runs emit for crawl_method.

routes.description: Discovered page/app routes the Site Map renders. Each item is a path string or a {path,...} object.

params_discovered.description: Parameters discovered across the surface (names or {name,...} objects).

notable_sinks.description: Notable sinks/surfaces grouped by kind (the console reads this as a map, not a list).

api_endpoints.description: API surface — a grouped object (public/auth/oauth buckets) or a flat list, both tolerated.
